name: Today
overview: Scripture teaches believers to embrace the present day as a gift from the Lord, rejoicing in what He has made and trusting in His guidance and provision. The psalmist encourages us to seek God’s lovingkindness each morning and to walk uprightly, confident that the Lord will withhold no good thing from those who trust Him. Jesus further instructs us not to be anxious about tomorrow, emphasizing that each day has enough challenges of its own. Additionally, God’s presence is described as mighty and joyful, offering salvation and love that sustain us today.
